BL-1114 — A dead-lettered handoff can sit in a worktree inbox/new as *.handoff.dead after exhausted recovery with no role-visible next step — quarantine looks silent to the holder
What it solves: Source: specifier in_process residue from coder note 50_20260823T091237Z_000860 (completed into full-sweep without a ticket; orphaned claim-progress/nudge sidecars cleared 2026-08-24 via handoff_lib/remove-sidecars-of! so false "continue TASK" wakes stop). Related: BL-353, BL-365, BL-122 recovery, …
Approval context: Firm: a *.handoff.dead must never be a silent dead-end for the holding role after recovery is exhausted. Firm: corrupt quarantine and chase dead-letter share one visible escalate/announce surface.
Measured nuance for your call: Operator notify state already lists this file under announcedFilePaths,…
